beats.speech: You can't pay the rent, and your stuff is out on the street. You're not just broke.
You don't have a penny to your name.

card.headline: not a penny to your name

language_approval.notes: Line 1 'your stuff is on the street' -> 'out on the street' (natural eviction collocation). hard up (informal, Cambridge), strapped for cash (everyday, very common in news), not have a penny to your name (idiom, = no money at all) correct; spoken 'You don't have a penny to your name.' matches headline. Caps OK. Whole unit re-read.
